name: management-information-system
description: Management information system dashboard for a multi-divisional business: sales vs budget, pipeline forecast, net-profit bridge, receivables ageing and working capital, plus a grounded Ask-the-MIS panel. Static React and TypeScript, seeded synthetic data, 527 reconciliation checks. Live demo included.

paragraphs: A management information system dashboard for a fictional, unnamed multi-divisional engineering group, built to answer five questions a division head asks every month.
features: Multi-vertical (electrical distribution, cooling, mechanical systems, pumps and water, vertical transport, metering, automation, fabrication, trading and services), each with its own full sheet of sales, profit,…
527 of 527 reconciliation assertions pass, checked independently of the generator by re-reading the written JSON and asserting every figure published in more than one place ties exactly.

165 browser interaction checks (Playwright, against a served build) cover page structure, keyboard traversal, chart behaviour and error resilience, including negative controls that prove each check can actually fail.

Three named themes, Parchment, Light and Dark, measured across 75 contrast pairs by a gate that reads the color tokens directly out of the stylesheet, so the palette cannot silently drift out of WCAG compliance.
Ten charts, and every one carries a view switch offering two or three readings of the same data, remembered per chart across a reload.

whatItDoes.text: A management information system dashboard for a fictional, unnamed multi-divisional engineering group, built to answer five questions a division head asks every month.
